@graph.name: Blue Dream
@graph.description: The sativa-dominant hybrid Blue Dream is a favorite strain for both novice and veteran cannabis consumers. Its fragrance consists of a light and sweet blueberry perfume with a woody undertone. When harvest-ready, its buds are light green and often quite sticky with lots of trichomes and bright orange hairs. The THC level of this strain falls at around 15%, just enough for both experienced and first-time users to enjoy the effects of its high. The peak THC level for Blue Dream is approximately 21%. Its high consists of cerebral activity and a healthy body buzz with a delicate balance between sativa and indica effects. Blue Dream is a good wake-and- bake strain, relieving tension in the body while increasing both creativity and energy to the consumer. Blue Dream will induce the munchies. Recommended consumption time is no later than two hours before bedtime. Besides cotton mouth and dry eyes, paranoia may surface if too much is consumed. Growers recommend indoor cultivation for this strain because it is susceptible to spider mite infestations.

isRelatedTo.name: Blueberry
isRelatedTo.description: This skunky yet fruity indica-dominant hybrid leaves an indulging, sweet aftertaste on the palate once consumed. Like its name suggests, Blueberry has a delicious taste and aroma of ripe blueberries. It’s known for its beautiful hues of purples and indigos, with patches of white trichomes covering its calyxes surrounded with golden hairs. Blueberry’s parent strains are a cross between the indica Afghani and two sativas of Thai and Purple Thai. It first emerged in the late 1970s and is the brainchild of the breeder DJ Short. Becoming quite popular all over the world, Blueberry has been recognized for its potent effects by winning the High Times 2000 Cannabis Cup for Best Indica. This potent strain is known to boast average THC levels at around 20%. Its high is known to last up to 3-4 hours while placing you in a sedative state, meaning you will get comfy and not want to move. Consumers of this strain have said mood definitely improves, allowing negativities to disappear as both body and mind slip into a peaceful euphoria. Reviewers have also noted it can be pretty difficult to hold conversations and be social when using this strain, so ensure you’ll be in a comfortable environment after consuming Blueberry. Common terpenes found in Blueberry include Beta-Caryophyllene, Alpha Humulene, Alpha Pinene, and Beta Myrcene. With a flowering time of about 8 weeks, this strain is recommended to be grown outdoors.

isRelatedTo.name: Haze
isRelatedTo.description: The infamous sativa cannabis strain, Haze, is known throughout the world and has become a popular sativa through the past several decades. Its smell and taste are sweet and somewhat citrusy, tasting of earthy spices and herbs. When harvest-ready, its buds are a diverse range of green shades that bare orange pistils. Haze first blossomed in Santa Cruz, California in the 60s, soon becoming the parent strain for a vast variety of hybrids across the world. Its parent strains are extremely diverse, being a cross between four different sativas: South American, Thai, Mexican, and South Indian. The THC content averages at a high of 18%, and can reach astonishing levels of 27%. Its high is unique and potent, creating a strong euphoric mindset the induces lots of cerebral activity that can cloud one’s thoughts. However, it’s known to increase creativity vastly and cause music and art to be more pleasurable. Haze produces a dreamy and happy high, while easing some minor aches throughout the body. Nausea is often alleviated and appetite increased. Consumers have noted that this strain can cause headaches and paranoia if consumed improperly, along with slight phases of dizziness. Haze requires ten to twelve weeks to flowers, growing best in indoor or desert climates.

@graph.name: Frequently Asked Questions about Blue Dream Strain - Hybrid Cannabis Review, 30% THC, 1.0% CBD & 1mg/g Caryophyllene

acceptedAnswer.text: Blue Dream is a popular and widely recognized sativa-leaning hybrid strain known for its balanced effects and pleasant flavor profile.

mainEntity.name: Where does Blue Dream come from?

acceptedAnswer.text: Blue Dream is a cross of Blueberry and Haze.

mainEntity.name: What does Blue Dream smell like?

acceptedAnswer.text: Blue Dream has a sweet and fruity aroma, often with notes of blueberries that is mixed with a herbal and woody undertone.

mainEntity.name: What does Blue Dream taste like?

acceptedAnswer.text: Blue Dream tastes of a blend of sweetness and earthiness, with hints of blueberries and other fruity undertones. It offers a smooth and enjoyable taste experience, with a touch of herbal notes.

mainEntity.name: What color does Blue Dream have?

acceptedAnswer.text: Blue Dream's buds are dense, chunky and come in shades of bright green that can have deep blue hues. The buds are joined by orange pistils that pop in constract against the thick silver coating of trichomes.

mainEntity.name: What effects does Blue Dream have?

acceptedAnswer.text: Blue Dream is loved for its balanced effects, combining both physical relaxation and mental stimulation. Consumers sate it starts with a gentle and uplifting rush that brings them blissful energy. In the body they note feeling relaxed and calm. Some individuals have said it is helpful for managing stress, anxiety, and mild to moderate pain.

mainEntity.name: Is Blue Dream an Indica, Sativa, or Hybrid?

acceptedAnswer.text: Blue Dream is sativa-dominant hybrid strain.
